properties.markdownProperty:
A **Functional requirement** for each desired behavior of the system that has not been specified by means of use cases: report generation, functionalities common to several use cases, periodic tasks, etc.
To illustrate a requirement, its *Description* can include an image, for example a possible layout of a report, with the syntax `![alternative text](assets:///file.png)`, where `file.png` is an image of the *assets* folder of the project. A figure can be added this way in any Markdown text, not only in this kind of requirement.
